physicalDescription.scarsAndMarks: Opekotina 2. stupnja na lijevoj ruci (Second-degree burn on left hand)

sections.title: Secret Heritage
content: Son of Aleksandar Vuk (closely guarded secret)
Uses mother's maiden name (Zekovich) to hide connection
Mother's family: old money with ties to Partija
Even Titovsky (Vuk's former right-hand man) doesn't know
Wolf is his family line symbol (inherited from Vuk)

sections.title: Rise in Police
content: Graduated Magna Cum Laude from Police Academy
Youngest detective to make rank
Rising star with stellar reputation
Uses his position to access evidence, manipulate records, cover tracks

sections.title: Resources
content: Inherited Vuk's hidden assets and some loyalist connections
Mother's old money family provides additional resources
Police salary and access
Can hire muscle and coordinate operations

coreTraits: Driven by dual motives: revenge and ambition
Charismatic enough to be a 'rising star'
Willing to betray anyone, including his own people
Cold pragmatism masks deep emotional wounds
motivations: Avenge his father's death (suspects Sek killed Vuk)
Prove himself worthy of Vuk's legacy (while hiding it)
Punish those who destroyed his father's regime
internalConflicts: Cannot publicly claim his father's legacy
Using Young Conquerors (half his people) as tools
The burn scar may symbolize early trauma

details: Vuk hid his son to protect him
Zekovich carries the weight of this legacy
Driven to avenge and succeed where father failed
Titovsky doesn't know Zekovich is Vuk's son
Secretly planning to eliminate Titovsky and take over
Uses Titovsky's resources while undermining him
Recruited them into smuggling network (for Titovsky)
Killed Hal to cover his tracks and frame others
Recognized as a threat to the operation
Framed with forged reports (using stolen signature)
Tried to kill him in the ambush
Says 'wolf phrase' on radio (unconsciously revealing connection)
Will be killed by Sek in final confrontation

sections.title: The Hidden Threat
content: Appears to be a promising young detective
Actually orchestrating the entire conspiracy
Operating from inside the system
Using his badge as cover

sections.title: The Ambush (Before Story Begins)
content: Planned to ambush Titovsky and Hal at their meeting
Kill Titovsky, eliminate Hal, seize the Red Death shipment
Rydeovich unexpectedly present - tried to kill him too
Partial success: Hal dead, Titovsky and Rydeovich wounded, shipment seized

sections.title: The Takeover Plan
content: Uses detective authority to push gangs out of Esseg
Raids, pressure, warnings about 'crackdown'
Clears the board for his own operation
Arranges deal with gangs outside Esseg on his terms
Will become the new supplier, cutting Titovsky out entirely

sections.title: The Frame Job
content: Forged reports to frame Rydeovich
Used stolen signature, own handwriting for content
Buried the reports to make it look like Rydeovich was covering up
Nearly works until Sek/Veckurius cross-reference handwriting

sections.title: The Revelation
content: His use of the 'wolf phrase' on police radio alerts Sek
Sek recognizes the words Vuk spoke while dying
Investigation reveals Zekovich is Vuk's son
Truth comes out in Chapter 5

characterArc.before: Brilliant young detective hiding dark agenda
characterArc.after: Exposed as Vuk's son seeking revenge and power, then killed

skillsAndAbilities: Access to resources through family wealth

notableMoments.description: Executes the ambush, kills Hal, seizes Red Death shipment
Uses badge to push gangs out of Esseg (setting up his own deal)
Voice on police radio says the 'wolf phrase'
Handwriting on forged reports identified as his
Discovery that gangs have left Esseg (his doing)
Plan exposed - making deal tonight with gangs at location outside Esseg
Killed by Sek during special forces operation

storySignificance: Embodies the sins of the previous generation
His exploitation of Young Conquerors parallels larger themes
Represents how past traumas perpetuate violence
His death closes the Vuk chapter (until Book 3's revelations)

thematicRole.description: Must hide his true self to operate
Sek becomes what Zekovich accuses him of being

characterFunction: Strength: Operates from inside the system with legitimate authority
Weakness: Cannot reveal his true identity or motives
Irony: Killed by the man he sought to destroy (his distant cousin)
Tragedy: Had potential to be great, corrupted by inheritance

futureBooks: His death resolves the immediate threat
Vuk's legacy and bloodline technology remain relevant
The bunker and its secrets may appear in future books
